skill.name: community-marketing
skill.description: Guides community strategy, platform selection, launch planning, engagement rituals, ambassador programs, and health audits for community-led growth.
skill.summary: Create practical community growth plans, rituals, member journeys, and health audits.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All three static findings are false positives. The two external-command alerts are Markdown inline code and a fenced diagram, not executable shell usage. The network-reconnaissance alert is ordinary member-value guidance, with no scanning or discovery instructions.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 15 uses Markdown backticks around local context filenames. It instructs the assistant to read optional context files and does not execute shell commands.
Lines 56-60 are a Markdown fenced diagram showing a community flywheel. There is no command text, interpreter directive, or execution instruction.
Lines 46-47 describe member benefits such as exclusive knowledge and peer connections. They do not request scanning, enumeration, or reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Many teams launch communities without a clear member identity or activation loop. This skill turns goals, stage, and platform context into practical community plans.
actual_capabilities: Selects community platforms by audience, goal, and trade-offs across Slack, Discord, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, and forums.
Creates launch plans with founding member outreach, seeded discussions, culture setting, and weekly core loops.
Designs onboarding journeys, channel structures, welcome posts, direct messages, and recurring rituals.
Builds ambassador program briefs with selection criteria, benefits, enablement assets, and measurement plans.
Audits community health with DAU/MAU, new member post rate, thread replies, lurker ratio, and non-staff content.
limitations: Does not manage community platforms or automate moderation actions.
Requires honest context about audience, goals, available time, and current metrics for precise recommendations.
Cannot guarantee member growth, retention, revenue, or referral outcomes.
May need legal, privacy, or moderation review for regulated or sensitive communities.

use_cases.title: Launch a B2B SaaS Community
use_cases.description: Choose a platform, define the member identity, recruit founding members, and plan the first 90 days.

use_cases.title: Revive Low Engagement
use_cases.description: Audit posting behavior, diagnose activation gaps, and create rituals that make participation easier.

use_cases.title: Create an Advocate Program
use_cases.description: Identify helpful members, define benefits, prepare enablement assets, and track referrals or engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Community Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: We are building a community for [audience]. Our goal is [goal]. Compare Slack, Discord, Circle, Reddit, and forums for this use case.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Community Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-day community launch plan for [product]. Include founding member outreach, seeded discussions, onboarding, rituals, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Engagement Drop-Off
prompt_templates.prompt: Our community has [member count] members, but [engagement problem]. Diagnose likely causes and recommend the top three fixes for the next month.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Growth System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a community-led growth system for [brand]. Include identity, core loop, ambassador criteria, support deflection, health metrics, and operating cadence.

output_examples.input: We are a B2B SaaS choosing between Slack and Discord.
output_examples.output: Recommended direction: Slack, if members work in a professional buying context. Watch the free tier history limit and plan a clear onboarding path.

output_examples.input: We have 40 members, but only three post regularly.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: this is an activation problem. Start with personal welcomes, seeded prompts, a weekly ritual, and visible recognition for early contributors.

output_examples.input: We need an ambassador program for 5,000 members.
output_examples.output: Start with members who already help others. Offer recognition, direct product input, referral tools, and a monthly review of impact.

best_practices: Define the member identity before choosing channels or growth tactics.
Recruit founding members manually, then seed visible conversations before public launch.
Track health weekly and connect community insights back to product decisions.
anti_patterns: Opening publicly before there is baseline activity or clear cultural guidance.
Treating the community as a support deflection channel without recognizing peer contributors.
Offering generic ambassador perks that do not match member motivation.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It compares Slack, Discord, Circle, Reddit, Facebook Groups, and forums by audience, discovery, search, and moderation needs.

faq.question: Can it help with a new community?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates launch plans with founding member outreach, seeded conversations, culture guidance, and first-week activation.

faq.question: Can it audit an existing community?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews engagement signals, posting patterns, unanswered questions, lurker ratio, and non-staff contribution levels.

faq.question: Does it create ambassador programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines candidate criteria, benefits, enablement assets, personal outreach, and measurement plans.

faq.question: Does this skill automate posting or moderation?
faq.answer: No. It provides strategy, planning, templates, and audits. Platform actions remain manual or handled by other tools.

faq.question: Can it use existing product marketing context?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions check for product marketing context files before asking for missing information.
